pose: Side view of the torso. Strong ribs and a backbone with ossified (bony) tendons visible.
visual_hook: The 'Criss-Cross Back'. You can see bony 'strings' crossing over the backbone to make it extra stiff and strong.
material: Matte, ochre-toned bone. Dry and textured.
inset_view: Top-right corner: Close-up of the bony tendons looking like stiff wires along the spine.
